---
title: Exercise — Open Vendor OCT Formats
---

## Objective

Open one sample from each of the major OCT vendor formats using public‑domain tools.

## Steps

1. Obtain sample files (Heidelberg `.e2e`, Topcon `.fda`, Zeiss `.img`) from public datasets or your institution (ensure license allows use).
2. Use `pydicom` to read DICOM tags and pixel data.
3. For non‑DICOM formats, use appropriate libraries (e.g., `tifffile` for some TIFF‑based OCT) or vendor SDKs if available.
4. Print key metadata (modality, bits stored, rows/columns) and display a B‑scan.

## Deliverable

A notebook `open_oct_formats.ipynb` with code and screenshots.
